description:
Close-out of the heap fold. Everything stated must be a present-tense fact grounded in the code as landed.

Done when:
- .agent/docs: the heap doc describes one block list counted by fill, the collect-now predicate as a function of state, the to-space floor at copyable bytes with the bands as policy above it, the unbounded size table with exact blocks above the pooled classes, the measured one-block gift, and the single root set. Every sentence about the pressure flag, adopted blocks as a separate list, fragments, the 6 MiB limit, quiet quanta, or dtors in a gift is gone. runtime-telemetry.md lists the GcStats fields that remain and no others. .agent/docs.md index updated.
- guides/memory.html and any other guide that describes process memory or message cost reflects the same facts in user terms: a message is measured, copied once by the sender into one block, and adopted by the receiver; a collection is sized to hold everything that could survive.
- README.md checked and updated where it describes the heap or messaging.
- The epic's proposal page (https://claude.ai/artifact/Wx4cwENxiEe7qPfqni84ZN) gains a section recording the BEAM comparison and the removal ledger as landed.
- The PR #279 description is rewritten from the diff against the branch root to cover the fold (ELI5 style: why, what changed, how it works, with the probe as the worked example).
- Full gate green. Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form. No co-author trailer.

Tests: none new. Each doc claim is checked against the code by the reviewer before close.
title: Agent docs, guides and the PR describe the folded heap
